alex: Heads-up — main is CI red on group-tests after yesterday's lockfile refresh. Multiple tests failing in tests/serializers/test_proto_roundtrip.py.
alex: Example from the job log: 
```
E   AttributeError: 'Descriptor' object has no attribute 'full_name'
/venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/google/protobuf/descriptor.py:412 in some_fn
```
alex: This started after the poetry lock update that bumped protobuf — not 100% sure yet. tagging for triage @priya @jordan
priya: ugh. ok can you paste the failing pipeline id? i'll kick off a rerun first just to rule flakiness
jordan: if it's deterministic we should bisect the lockfile to find which transitive changed. I can take it if you give me the two lockfile commits (before/after).
ci-bot: Pipeline #5421 — group-tests · failed · https://ci.internal/5421 (job: py-tests/group-tests)
maya: rerun triggered (job 5422). If 5422 passes, ignore me. If it fails, we'll bisect. :crossed_fingers:
alex: 5422 failed with the same stack. i'll paste the two lockfile commits — before: c3f8a2e, after: 9b7d4f1 (the PR was deps/update-lock-2026-02-28).
jordan: thanks. starting a local bisect across lockfile changes now. approx steps: 
```bash
# checkout main at before commit
git checkout c3f8a2e && cp poetry.lock /tmp/lock.before
# checkout after
git checkout 9b7d4f1 && cp poetry.lock /tmp/lock.after
# iterate replacing lockfile in CI image and running tests
```
jordan: first pass points at protobuf 4.25.0 -> 4.26.0 bump as suspect.
li: we saw protobuf bumps break generated code before because of small API churn. which top-level package pulled it? maybe grpcio or google-cloud-core?
priya: checking pyproject.lock transitive graph now. Looks like grpcio pinned to ^1.58 pulled protobuf 4.26.0 via googleapis-common-protos.
maya: can you reproduce locally with `pip install -c constraints.txt -r requirements-ci.txt`? I can try a quick venv test.
li: quick repro: create venv, `pip install protobuf==4.26.0`, run the failing test file -> reproduces the AttributeError immediately. Downgrading to 4.24.0 makes the test pass.
jordan: ok confirmed with bisect — protobuf 4.26.0 introduced change that breaks our generated serializers. I'll open a minimal repro and link it.
aj: (note: aj not in thread)
priya: thanks. action items: pin protobuf <4.26 in the lockfile constraints and open a hotfix PR that updates poetry.lock (or add a constraints file for CI).@jordan want to own the PR?
jordan: I will open PR to add a dev constraint `protobuf<4.26` and regenerate lock to lock to 4.24.0. Will include a test run in CI. ETA: ~1h. :hammer_and_wrench:
alex: awesome, thanks. once PR is up i'll merge if green. Also we should add a short note in the changelog about protobuf compatibility for generated code.
priya: ping me on the PR for review.
ci-bot: Rerun required after PR merge. :ok_hand:
alex: closing loop here — big thanks to jordan and li for the quick bisect. :tada:
